subject: Close-pace realignment: confirm stage or move to archive
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close-pace realignment: confirm stage or move to archive

Team —

Finance asked for a quick sweep of deals > $50k to clean up close dates and stage truth ahead of tomorrow's forecast lock. We need owners to confirm one of three outcomes for each assigned opportunity in the next 48 hours:

1) Commit — update stage to Closed/Won or Commit and set an expected close date
2) At-risk — keep in pipeline but move stage to "Best Effort" and flag next step + blocker
3) Archive/Stale — no recent engagement or executive objection; mark with "no_commit" tag and move to Close Date > 90 days or archive list

Please prioritize deals with missing close dates or where Close Date > Stage (e.g., in Opportunity Stage but Close Date outside quarter). I attached a quick CSV (Q2_pipeline_snapshot.csv) with your assigned deals and suggested actions.

What I need from each owner by 4pm PT on Friday: a) update SF record OR b) reply-all with explicit decision for each deal you can’t update. I’ll run a reconcile on Monday and move unverified deals to the stale bucket for forecast hygiene.

If you think a deal merits an exception (e.g., legal is redlining / procurement blocks), call it out with a one-line rationale and link to the doc.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q2_pipeline_snapshot.csv (spreadsheet)]
